title: Securing the Infrastructure of Intelligence
excerpt: Land, Power and Shell: The Next Critical Resource for AI factories.
content_html:
AI factories are the defining infrastructure of the AI era — where compute transforms energy and data into intelligence that powers every business, industry and country.

In the AI economy, compute is revenue.

AI factories require a full stack of critical resources: advanced chips, packaging, memory, and networking — as well as land, power and shell.

Just as NVIDIA has used its scale, long-term visibility and supply-chain partnerships to secure critical semiconductor resources, we are now applying that same discipline to secure LPS capacity exclusively for NVIDIA AI factories.

Today, we are partnering with SB Energy to secure LPS capacity at the exceptional PORTS-Pike Technology Campus in Portsmouth, Ohio, to host NVIDIA compute. OpenAI will be the tenant.

LPS: The Next Strategic Resource

For the vast majority of NVIDIA customers, securing LPS has long been a part of their infrastructure strategy.

The world’s largest cloud service providers and investment-grade enterprises have balance sheets, infrastructure expertise, and long-term contracts to secure LPS independently. They build and operate AI factories using NVIDIA accelerated computing, networking, systems and software.

This model will continue to represent most of NVIDIA’s business.

But frontier AI labs are different.

Frontier AI labs have extraordinary demand for training and inference compute, but many are growing faster than their balance sheets and long-term credit profiles can support. They may have strong customer demand and rapidly growing revenue yet still lack the decades-long infrastructure contracts and investment-grade financing capacity needed to secure the AI factory infrastructure independently.

Their growth is increasingly constrained not by algorithms or customer demand, but by the availability of compute.

For these companies, more compute means more intelligence, more products, more users and more revenue. NVIDIA is helping provide the infrastructure that powers this flywheel.

PORTS-Pike: A Site for Generations of NVIDIA Compute

OpenAI will build and operate a world-class AI factory at PORTS-Pike. The AI factory will use NVIDIA’s full-stack DSX AI factory platform, including GPUs, CPUs, networking, and infrastructure software.  

The initial deployment is expected to provide 4.25 gigawatts of AI factory capacity. Each generation of NVIDIA AI factory systems deployed at PORTS-Pike could represent approximately 1.5 million NVIDIA GPUs, or approximately $150 billion to $200 billion in NVIDIA revenue. Over 20 years, the site can support multiple upgrade cycles. 

This is the essential economic point: the LPS commitment secures a long-lived AI factory site, while the NVIDIA compute inside can be upgraded repeatedly. Each new generation can deliver greater production, more intelligence and better economics. 

NVIDIA may also choose to extend the arrangement at PORTS-Pike beyond the initial 4.25 gigawatts to secure the remaining capacity of 3.75 gigawatts. 

OpenAI and NVIDIA Expanding Compute Opportunity

More broadly, OpenAI has committed to substantial deployments of NVIDIA AI infrastructure through 2030. OpenAI’s existing and planned commitments represent approximately 12 gigawatts of NVIDIA compute, with an opportunity to expand to approximately 16 gigawatts if NVIDIA extends the PORTS-Pike arrangement beyond the initial 4.25 gigawatts. 

At these levels, the opportunity represents roughly $600 billion of NVIDIA compute through 2030. 

The Important Questions

What is NVIDIA guaranteeing, and for how long?

NVIDIA is supporting the LPS infrastructure at PORTS-Pike for approximately 4 gigawatts over a 20-year term, securing a site on which NVIDIA compute will be exclusively deployed.  

Our support is limited to defined portions of lease and power payments, along with a specified residual-value commitment — not the full cost of the site or all of the tenant’s obligations.   

The guarantee will become effective in phases as data centers are placed in service between 2028 and 2030.  As OpenAI makes lease payments and capacity comes online, NVIDIA’s remaining exposure declines.

Why is NVIDIA guaranteeing PORTS-Pike?

LPS has become a critical constraint on AI factory deployment. NVIDIA is selectively securing exceptional sites where we can host multiple generations of NVIDIA compute and serve durable customer demand. 

The productive life of the site extends through multiple generations of NVIDIA systems, each capable of producing more intelligence and more revenue than the generation before.

Is this circular financing?

No. OpenAI will pay the lease.   

NVIDIA uses its scale and long-term visibility to secure PORTS-Pike to host NVIDIA compute. This is the same discipline we apply to supply-chain management: we secure critical inputs when we have visibility into customer demand and when doing so enables long-term productive capacity.

What happens to PORTS-Pike if OpenAI does not use the site in the future?

NVIDIA compute is versatile, fungible and broadly adopted. The capacity can be resold to another qualified tenant across NVIDIA’s global ecosystem of cloud service providers, enterprises, AI labs and startups. 

CUDA makes NVIDIA compute more than hardware. It gives developers and NVIDIA engineers a common platform to continually improve installed systems. 

CUDA makes NVIDIA compute versatile. Versatility makes it fungible. Fungibility drives utilization and durability — making NVIDIA compute a productive asset: rentable and financeable. 

The value of an exceptional site, like PORTS-Pike, is not limited to one customer or one generation of compute. NVIDIA’s standardized platform, broad developer ecosystem and large market of potential users support the ability to redeploy productive capacity over time.

How much LPS will NVIDIA secure?

It will be strategic and disciplined. 

Most NVIDIA customers will continue to secure their own LPS.  The vast majority of LPS hosting NVIDIA compute will continue to be secured directly by CSPs, enterprises, sovereign AI builders and other customers. 

NVIDIA will focus selectively on exceptional sites where visible, durable demand can support multiple generations of NVIDIA compute.

PORTS-Pike represents the next step in NVIDIA’s journey. 

We began by building accelerated computing chips. We then expanded to systems, networking, CUDA and full-stack AI factories. Today, we are helping secure the critical infrastructure required to build these factories. 

NVIDIA is the full-stack AI infrastructure platform. 

We are investing in the long-lived foundations of AI factories so our customers can deploy the most productive compute platform in the world, generation after generation. 

By securing the critical resources needed to host NVIDIA compute, we can help the world’s most innovative companies build the AI factories that will power the age of intelligence.

blocks.html_en: CUDA makes NVIDIA compute more than hardware. It gives developers and NVIDIA engineers a common platform to continually improve installed systems.

sentences.en: CUDA makes NVIDIA compute more than hardware.
sentences.zh: CUDA 使 NVIDIA 的计算能力不仅仅局限于硬件。

sentences.en: It gives developers and NVIDIA engineers a common platform to continually improve installed systems.
sentences.zh: 它为开发人员和 NVIDIA 工程师提供了一个通用平台来不断改进已安装的系统。

blocks.html_en: CUDA makes NVIDIA compute versatile. Versatility makes it fungible. Fungibility drives utilization and durability — making NVIDIA compute a productive asset: rentable and financeable.

sentences.en: CUDA makes NVIDIA compute versatile.
sentences.zh: CUDA 使 NVIDIA 计算变得多功能。

sentences.en: Versatility makes it fungible.
sentences.zh: 多功能性使其具有可替代性。

sentences.en: Fungibility drives utilization and durability — making NVIDIA compute a productive asset: rentable and financeable.
sentences.zh: 可替代性可提高利用率和耐用性，使 NVIDIA 计算成为一种生产性资产：可出租且可融资。

blocks.html_en: The value of an exceptional site, like PORTS-Pike, is not limited to one customer or one generation of compute. NVIDIA’s standardized platform, broad developer ecosystem and large market of potential users support the ability to redeploy productive capacity over time.

sentences.en: The value of an exceptional site, like PORTS-Pike, is not limited to one customer or one generation of compute.
sentences.zh: 像 PORTS-Pike 这样的特殊站点的价值并不局限于一个客户或一代计算。

sentences.en: NVIDIA’s standardized platform, broad developer ecosystem and large market of potential users support the ability to redeploy productive capacity over time.
sentences.zh: NVIDIA 的标准化平台、广泛的开发者生态系统和庞大的潜在用户市场支持随着时间的推移重新部署生产能力的能力。

blocks.html_en: How much LPS will NVIDIA secure?

sentences.en: How much LPS will NVIDIA secure?
sentences.zh: NVIDIA 将确保多少 LPS？

blocks.html_en: It will be strategic and disciplined.

sentences.en: It will be strategic and disciplined.
sentences.zh: 它将具有战略性和纪律性。

blocks.html_en: Most NVIDIA customers will continue to secure their own LPS.  The vast majority of LPS hosting NVIDIA compute will continue to be secured directly by CSPs, enterprises, sovereign AI builders and other customers.

sentences.en: Most NVIDIA customers will continue to secure their own LPS.
sentences.zh: 大多数 NVIDIA 客户将继续保护自己的 LPS。

sentences.en: The vast majority of LPS hosting NVIDIA compute will continue to be secured directly by CSPs, enterprises, sovereign AI builders and other customers.
sentences.zh: 托管 NVIDIA 计算的绝大多数 LPS 将继续由 CSP、企业、主权 AI 构建者和其他客户直接保护。

blocks.html_en: NVIDIA will focus selectively on exceptional sites where visible, durable demand can support multiple generations of NVIDIA compute.

sentences.en: NVIDIA will focus selectively on exceptional sites where visible, durable demand can support multiple generations of NVIDIA compute.
sentences.zh: NVIDIA 将有选择地关注特殊站点，这些站点的可见、持久需求可以支持多代 NVIDIA 计算。

blocks.html_en: PORTS-Pike represents the next step in NVIDIA’s journey.

sentences.en: PORTS-Pike represents the next step in NVIDIA’s journey.
sentences.zh: PORTS-Pike 代表了 NVIDIA 旅程的下一步。

blocks.html_en: We began by building accelerated computing chips. We then expanded to systems, networking, CUDA and full-stack AI factories. Today, we are helping secure the critical infrastructure required to build these factories.

sentences.en: We began by building accelerated computing chips.
sentences.zh: 我们首先构建加速计算芯片。

sentences.en: We then expanded to systems, networking, CUDA and full-stack AI factories.
sentences.zh: 然后我们扩展到系统、网络、CUDA 和全栈人工智能工厂。

sentences.en: Today, we are helping secure the critical infrastructure required to build these factories.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们正在帮助确保建设这些工厂所需的关键基础设施的安全。

blocks.html_en: NVIDIA is the full-stack AI infrastructure platform.

sentences.en: NVIDIA is the full-stack AI infrastructure platform.
sentences.zh: NVIDIA 是全栈人工智能基础设施平台。

blocks.html_en: We are investing in the long-lived foundations of AI factories so our customers can deploy the most productive compute platform in the world, generation after generation.

sentences.en: We are investing in the long-lived foundations of AI factories so our customers can deploy the most productive compute platform in the world, generation after generation.
sentences.zh: 我们正在投资于人工智能工厂的长期基础，以便我们的客户能够一代又一代地部署世界上最高效的计算平台。

blocks.html_en: By securing the critical resources needed to host NVIDIA compute, we can help the world’s most innovative companies build the AI factories that will power the age of intelligence.

sentences.en: By securing the critical resources needed to host NVIDIA compute, we can help the world’s most innovative companies build the AI factories that will power the age of intelligence.
sentences.zh: 通过确保托管 NVIDIA 计算所需的关键资源，我们可以帮助世界上最具创新力的公司建立人工智能工厂，为智能时代提供动力。

content_html_zh:
人工智能工厂是人工智能时代的决定性基础设施——计算将能源和数据转化为智能，为每个企业、行业和国家提供动力。

在人工智能经济中，计算就是收入。

人工智能工厂需要一整套关键资源：先进的芯片、封装、内存和网络，以及土地、电力和外壳。

正如 NVIDIA 利用其规模、长期可见性和供应链合作伙伴关系来确保关键的半导体资源一样，我们现在也采用同样的原则来确保专门为 NVIDIA AI 工厂提供 LPS 产能。

今天，我们与 SB Energy 合作，确保俄亥俄州朴茨茅斯卓越的 PORTS-Pike 技术园区的 LPS 容量能够托管 NVIDIA 计算。 OpenAI 将成为租户。

LPS：下一个战略资源

对于绝大多数 NVIDIA 客户来说，保护 LPS 长期以来一直是其基础设施战略的一部分。

全球最大的云服务提供商和投资级企业拥有资产负债表、基础设施专业知识和长期合同来独立保护 LPS。 他们使用 NVIDIA 加速计算、网络、系统和软件构建和运营人工智能工厂。

该模型将继续代表 NVIDIA 的大部分业务。

但前沿人工智能实验室则不同。

前沿人工智能实验室对训练和推理计算有着巨大的需求，但许多实验室的增长速度超出了其资产负债表和长期信用状况所能支持的速度。 他们可能拥有强劲的客户需求和快速增长的收入，但仍然缺乏独立确保人工智能工厂基础设施所需的长达数十年的基础设施合同和投资级融资能力。

它们的增长越来越不受算法或客户需求的限制，而是受到计算可用性的限制。

对于这些公司来说，更多的计算意味着更多的智能、更多的产品、更多的用户和更多的收入。 NVIDIA 正在帮助提供为该飞轮提供动力的基础设施。

PORTS-Pike：世代 NVIDIA 计算的网站

OpenAI 将在 PORTS-Pike 建设并运营一座世界级的人工智能工厂。 该AI工厂将使用NVIDIA的全栈DSX AI工厂平台，包括GPU、CPU、网络和基础设施软件。

初步部署预计将提供4.25吉瓦的人工智能工厂产能。 PORTS-Pike 部署的每一代 NVIDIA AI 工厂系统可代表约 150 万个 NVIDIA GPU，或约 1500 亿至 2000 亿美元的 NVIDIA 收入。 20多年来，该站点可以支持多个升级周期。

这是最重要的经济点：LPS 承诺确保了一个长期存在的 AI 工厂站点，而内部的 NVIDIA 计算可以重复升级。 每一代新产品都可以带来更高的产量、更多的智能和更好的经济效益。

NVIDIA 还可能选择将 PORTS-Pike 的安排扩展到最初的 4.25 吉瓦以外，以确保剩余的 3.75 吉瓦容量。

OpenAI 和 NVIDIA 扩大计算机会

更广泛地说，OpenAI 承诺到 2030 年大规模部署 NVIDIA AI 基础设施。 OpenAI 现有和计划的承诺代表大约 12 吉瓦的 NVIDIA 计算，如果 NVIDIA 将 PORTS-Pike 安排扩展到最初的 4.25 吉瓦之外，则有机会扩展到大约 16 吉瓦。

按照这些水平，到 2030 年，这一机会代表 NVIDIA 计算价值约为 6000 亿美元。

重要问题

NVIDIA 提供什么保证以及保证多久？

NVIDIA 将在 20 年内为 PORTS-Pike 的 LPS 基础设施提供约 4 吉瓦的电力支持，确保专门部署 NVIDIA 计算的站点。

我们的支持仅限于租赁和电费的规定部分，以及指定的剩余价值承诺，而不是场地的全部成本或租户的所有义务。

随着数据中心在 2028 年至 2030 年间投入使用，该保证将分阶段生效。 随着 OpenAI 支付租金和产能上线，NVIDIA 的剩余风险下降。

NVIDIA 为何为 PORTS-Pike 提供保证？

LPS已成为AI工厂部署的关键制约因素。 NVIDIA 有选择地保护特殊站点，以便我们可以托管多代 NVIDIA 计算并满足持久的客户需求。

该网站的生产寿命延续了多代 NVIDIA 系统，每代系统都比前一代能够产生更多的智能和更多的收入。

这是循环融资吗？

不会。OpenAI 将支付租金。

NVIDIA 利用其规模和长期可见性来确保 PORTS-Pike 能够托管 NVIDIA 计算。 这与我们应用于供应链管理的原则相同：当我们了解客户需求并实现长期生产能力时，我们就能确保关键投入。

如果 OpenAI 将来不再使用 PORTS-Pike 网站，会发生什么情况？

NVIDIA 计算功能多样、可替代且被广泛采用。 这些容量可以转售给 NVIDIA 全球云服务提供商、企业、人工智能实验室和初创公司生态系统中的另一个合格租户。

CUDA 使 NVIDIA 的计算能力不仅仅局限于硬件。 它为开发人员和 NVIDIA 工程师提供了一个通用平台来不断改进已安装的系统。

CUDA 使 NVIDIA 计算变得多功能。 多功能性使其具有可替代性。 可替代性可提高利用率和耐用性，使 NVIDIA 计算成为一种生产性资产：可出租且可融资。

像 PORTS-Pike 这样的特殊站点的价值并不局限于一个客户或一代计算。 NVIDIA 的标准化平台、广泛的开发者生态系统和庞大的潜在用户市场支持随着时间的推移重新部署生产能力的能力。

NVIDIA 将确保多少 LPS？

它将具有战略性和纪律性。

大多数 NVIDIA 客户将继续保护自己的 LPS。 托管 NVIDIA 计算的绝大多数 LPS 将继续由 CSP、企业、主权 AI 构建者和其他客户直接保护。

NVIDIA 将有选择地关注特殊站点，这些站点的可见、持久需求可以支持多代 NVIDIA 计算。

PORTS-Pike 代表了 NVIDIA 旅程的下一步。

我们首先构建加速计算芯片。 然后我们扩展到系统、网络、CUDA 和全栈人工智能工厂。 今天，我们正在帮助确保建设这些工厂所需的关键基础设施的安全。

NVIDIA 是全栈人工智能基础设施平台。

我们正在投资于人工智能工厂的长期基础，以便我们的客户能够一代又一代地部署世界上最高效的计算平台。

通过确保托管 NVIDIA 计算所需的关键资源，我们可以帮助世界上最具创新力的公司建立人工智能工厂，为智能时代提供动力。
